mapper.select: SELECT D.DEPT_NM, COUNT(DISTINCT C.COURSE_ID) AS COURSE_CNT, SUM(CASE WHEN A.STATUS = 'DONE' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS DONE_CNT FROM TB_EDU_COURSE C JOIN TB_DEPT D ON D.DEPT_CD = C.DEPT_CD LEFT JOIN TB_EDU_APPLY A ON A.COURSE_ID = C.COURSE_ID WHERE C.EDU_YEAR = #{year} GROUP BY D.DEPT_NM
